name: Pluto Lost Its Colors
description:
About This Game

Highly addictive, fast paced platformer with physics based controls.

Pluto can roll, jump, and dash. Combine these actions to expand Pluto's movement capabilities with side rolls, high jumps, and more! Pluto may react unpredictably to every surface it touches, but with your mastery over its controls, you can counteract with even greater precision.

Journey Across Realms To Reclaim Pluto's Lost Colors!

Pluto loses its vibrant colors after being attached by a black hole. Determined to reclaim what was lost, Pluto embarks on a journey across the galaxy, facing numerous challenges while collecting color shards.

Challenging Levels!

Help Pluto reclaim its colors by collecting color shards in this fast paced and challenging platformer adventure. There are four realms to explore, with different challenges awaiting you. Take on a greater challenge and collect the coins scattered across realms to unlock unique accessories.

Join Pluto in its journey across the galaxy and help it find and reclaim its color shards!

  • Fast paced platformer with convenient checkpoints after each challenge.

  • Easy to learn with two action inputs, but hard to master with physics based movement.

  • Four unique realms to explore.

  • Hours of gameplay with 99 checkpoints, 4 boss battles, and 285 coins.

  • Evolving colors and accessories to collect.

  • Highly addictive and satisfying gameplay. You won't want to stop.

  • Battle with a BLACK HOLE !!!
short_desc: Join Pluto in its quest to reclaim its colors in this chaotic yet rewarding experience! Pluto Lost Its Colors is a fast paced platformer with physics based controls. Master the unpredictable physics of Pluto as you roll, jump, and dash through challenges. This game is your next addiction.
